instructions: Review against the project's rules in CLAUDE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md and the spec in docs/. Treat any reference to the live TradeStation API host, leaked secrets, request-derived identity, retried or unpersisted broker orders, or browser-supplied quantities as blocking. Prefer the least code that is obviously correct; flag hand-kept data that changes over time and hand-rolled code where a well-chosen library fits. Don't comment on formatting (Prettier and ESLint enforce it).
